function: Layer-wise DNN regressors inside partial MAP successive detection compute soft LLRs to recover transmitted MIMO symbols, feeding hard decisions or an FEC decoder (pp. 2, 5-6).
system: MIMO 2x2 and 4x4 with L >= K, BPSK and QPSK, rate-1/2 convolutional code; no RIS; frequency band not stated (pp. 3, 8-10).
method: DNN-aided partial MAP: one fully connected ReLU DNN per detection layer regresses local LLRs from extended input sets; supervised, MSE loss, Adam (pp. 5-8).
data_channel: Custom simulator: fixed or redrawn i.i.d. CN(0,1) Rayleigh and Kronecker-correlated Rayleigh (rho = 0.5); 5,000-10,000 training samples (Table III says 20,000), 100,000 test samples (pp. 8, 10).
test_conditions: Training and test channels of the same type (fixed, i.i.d. redrawn, or correlated); networks trained per SNR interval; 10% CSI error and 4/8-bit ADC robustness tests (pp. 8-12).
baselines: Non-learned: MAP, MMSE, ZF-SIC, AMP, partial MAP without DNN; learned: DetNet, ScNet, OAMP-Net (pp. 8-9).
metrics: BER, uncoded and with soft or hard FEC decoding; training samples and epochs to converge; computational complexity (pp. 7-12).
complexity: Operation counts per layer and total, compared with DetNet, ScNet, OAMP-Net (Table II, p. 7); PMAP-Net needs fewer operations than ScNet (pp. 6-7).
q1_support: p. 8: "Each element of H is generated from a CSCG distribution with mean zero and variance unity" and "The correlated Rayleigh MIMO channel can be expressed by Kronecker model [37]". Custom simulator with textbook models: no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 8: "remains unchanged for every sample during both training and testing phases" (time-invariant); p. 10: "MIMO channels are randomly generated for each sample both in training and testing phases" (time-varying). Training and test channels match; SNR-interval training (Fig. 3) and the 10% CSI error and ADC tests (pp. 11-12) are SNR or error sweeps; no other channel model, antenna number or modulation is tested without retraining.
q3_support: p. 8: "BER results comparing with several conventional low complexity suboptimal detection algorithms and deep learning-based detectors"; p. 9 lists MAP, MMSE, ZF-SIC and AMP (non-learned) and "DetNet, a paradigm of data-driven DL-based detectors", ScNet and OAMP-Net (learned); BER in Figs. 4-5.
q4_support: p. 7: "The computational complexities of DetNet, ScNet, OAMPNet, and PMAP-Net are summarized in Table II"; Eqs. (35)-(36) on pp. 6-7 give the operation count of PMAP-Net.
q5_support: p. 7: "the proposed PMAP-Net is implemented in TensorFlow 1.14.1" on a CPU; no code or data link, data generated by the authors' own simulator.
notes: Included as area 1: DNNs compute the LLRs in each layer of partial MAP detection (DNN-aided inference). q2 is 0: training and test channels match (time-invariant or time-varying), Fig. 3 trains per SNR interval or at one SNR (SNR sweep), and Section V-D tests 10% CSI error and 4/8-bit ADC without stating a different training condition; reviewer may check this. The text gives 5,000 and 10,000 training samples while Table III lists 20,000. Tables II and III read on the page 7 and 8 images.
